title: Darius Nothus
summary: Darius Nothus is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Persia, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only and is not converted to BC.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Darius Nothus 3 first 423). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 791a
reign.note: Year cell "4290 3608". To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 19 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Persia..

reign.citation: Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology and Geography, History and Prophecy, 2nd ed., corrected and improved (London: C. J. G. & F. Rivington, 1830), vol. II, Synopsis of the Chronology, p. xxxvii
reign.note: “3 first” is what he prints, not a full reign worked out past the page.

free_source_links.locator: 1830 second edition, four volumes, full view
